items.claim: Jann Horn 自述 Spectre/Meltdown 的披露协调细节：2017-06-01 报告给 Intel/AMD/ARM，但初始报告不含 variant 3——'We had discussed whether direct reads from kernel memory could work, but thought that it was unlikely'，后来才测试并报告 variant 3。公开披露在 2018-01-03，协调窗口约 7 个月，远超 P0 标准 90 天政策。他对 90 天硬立场未做明确辩护，而是把缓解设计责任推给厂商：'we believe that the processor vendors are in a much better position than we are to design and evaluate mitigations'。同时慷慨列出并发发现者（Gruss/Lipp/Yarom/Kocher 等），不主张优先权。
items.growth_signal: 披露协调中的转折点：variant 3 是事后补充发现（初始判断'unlikely'后被推翻）——显示'先假设、后用实验证伪'的迭代。7 个月例外未公开辩护，姿态务实低调；慷慨归因体现'概念整合者 + PoC 实现者'而非'概念原创者'的自我定位。

items.claim: Jann Horn 在 MSG_OOB 帖中公开记录多条失败与自我否定，而非隐藏走错的路：承认'I was too lazy to do that everywhere perfectly'；承认需要 >4GiB RAM 的指针递增策略'feels gross and a bit like cheating'；承认'Eventually, I realized that I had been going down the wrong path'与'Clearly trying to target a heap object was foolish'；承认'I spent a lot of time looking at various object types...but found nothing great'。研究缘起是偶然：'I was reviewing a new Linux kernel feature when I learned about the MSG_OOB feature'。
items.growth_signal: 把失败路径与自我纠正公开写进 writeup——这是可被他人学习的'研究过程留痕'，区别于只展示成功结果的写法。'review 新内核特性偶然发现'显示研究目标信号=新技术+暴露面错配（MSG_OOB 几乎无人用却在 Chrome 沙箱暴露）。

items.claim: Jann Horn 在 cache invalidation 帖中体现同伴反馈回路：致谢同事 Mark Brand 指出更简单路径——'Thanks to Mark for pointing out that if you control RDI and RIP, you don't have to try to do crazy things'（指原本考虑更复杂的 CR4 位翻转，Mark 指出可直接 spawn usermode helper）。方法论为穷举排除：逐一列举四种重用已释放 VMA 的方案并逐一给出否定技术理由，最终导出唯一可行路径（BPF maps 经 page allocator）。自嘲利用链质量：'it is quite crude (for example, it crashes after having done its job), but it works'，章节标题即态度'The exploit: JOP (the boring part)'。
items.growth_signal: 同伴反馈直接简化了利用路径（Mark 的指点省去 CR4 翻转的复杂度）——显示他接受同事纠正而非固守自己的更复杂方案。穷举排除法是可复现的方法论习惯：列所有可行路径逐一否定，而非试第一条就停。
items.short_quote: Thanks to Mark for pointing out that if you control RDI and RIP, you don't have to try to do crazy things like flipping the SM*P bits in CR4.

items.claim: Jann Horn 在 TLB/mremap 帖中主动承认自己漏掉了一个竞争窗口，被内核安全团队发现：'(I didn't notice that, but the kernel security team did)'——把次要发现的功劳归给他人。同时承认理论预测与实际不符：'(In theory, it seems like a single overwrite should be sufficient; but in practice, that doesn't seem to work)'，并坦承不确定原因：'I'm not sure whether this is caused by some sort of cache inconsistency...or whether I did something else wrong'。结尾以对手时间线收束：'It took more than two months for the upstream kernel change to make its way to user devices; writing an exploit for this bug took far less time.'并以签名句'Make zeroday hard.'结束。
